title: Szitizen Survival Guide
description: Essential tips and information to make your Sziget experience amazing, safe, and unforgettable. Everything here works offline, so you'll never be stranded.

items.title: Cup Recycling
items.content: Sziget uses a ReCup system. Do not throw cups away! Every cup can be returned for a token or reused to save money and the environment.

items.title: Eco-Toilets
items.content: Look for the Green Sziget zones for composting toilets. They save thousands of liters of water daily.

items.title: Don't Waste
items.content: If you see a tap left running or a full recycling bin, report it to a 'Green Scout' volunteer.

items.title: Cirque du Sziget
items.content: A massive outdoor venue featuring world-class contemporary circus acts from 2 PM until midnight daily.

items.title: Art Garden
items.content: Explore large-scale interactive installations hidden in the woods near the A38 stage.

items.title: Theater and Dance
items.content: Don't miss the morning yoga sessions and afternoon contemporary dance performances at the Giant Street Theater.

items.title: First Aid & Medical
items.content: First aid tents are clearly marked on the festival map. Don't hesitate to visit them for any issue, big or small. The staff is there to help.

items.title: Emergency Services
items.content: In a serious emergency, find the nearest security guard or staff member. The general emergency number in Hungary is 112.

items.title: Sun Protection
items.content: Budapest sun is intense. Use the UV Alert tool in the Toolkit and find shade between 1 PM and 4 PM.

items.title: CityPass Benefits
items.content: The Sziget CityPass by BKK includes free public transport, airport shuttle, and boat parties. Highly recommended.

items.title: Cashless System
items.content: Sziget is 100% cashless. Your wristband is your wallet. Top up via the official app or at points marked with 'TOP UP'.

items.title: Prohibited Items
items.content: Glass bottles, gas canisters, and professional cameras without permits are confiscated at the K-Bridge entrance.
